audience: domain owners and web teams who manage Gandi domains and LiveDNS zones

useCases.title: Find domains that expire soon
useCases.text: List domains that expire within a number of days you choose, soonest first. The result says if the list is complete. Open one domain for its life-cycle dates and autorenew setting.

useCases.title: List the domains that use LiveDNS
useCases.text: List the domains whose DNS is hosted in Gandi LiveDNS. List all domains of the token's user with their status.

useCases.title: Read the DNS records of a zone
useCases.text: List all record sets in a LiveDNS zone, with name, type, TTL and values. Read one record set by its name and type.

useCases.title: Point an existing DNS record to a new address
useCases.text: Read the record set first. Then replace its values and TTL. The change reaches live DNS and removes the old values.

useCases.title: Add a new DNS record to a zone
useCases.text: Create a DNS record set in a LiveDNS zone. The create fails if the name and type pair already exists.
